skill_drafts.name: Weighted Zone Scoring
skill_drafts.description: Assign differential weights to document zones (author, title, abstract, body) and compute ranked retrieval scores by combining zone-specific term frequencies. Use when documents have structured fields and relevance varies by field type.
skill_drafts.objective: Compute relevance scores that reflect zone importance in ranked retrieval
applicable_signals: Zone weights are defined or learnable
contraindications: Zone importance is unknown or uniform across all zones
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Index documents with zone encoding', 'detail': 'Encode zone information as extensions of dictionary entries or in postings list'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Assign or learn zone weights', 'detail': 'Define weight for each zone (e.g., author=2, title=4, abstract=3, body=1) based on domain relevance'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'For each query term, retrieve zone-specific frequencies', 'detail': 'Look up term in zone index; extract frequency in author, title, abstract, body zones'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Compute weighted zone contribution', 'detail': 'Multiply each zone frequency by its weight; sum across zones for single term score'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Aggregate scores across query terms', 'detail': 'Sum weighted scores for all query terms to produce final document score'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Rank and return results', 'detail': 'Sort documents by descending score; return ranked list with score breakdown by zone'}
triggers: Document collection has multiple structured zones (author, title, abstract, body)
Need to rank results by relevance with zone-specific importance
constraints: Zone weights must be assigned or learned before scoring
Zone index must encode zone information (either in dictionary or postings)
All candidate documents must have consistent zone structure
cautions: Zone weights significantly impact ranking; verify weights reflect actual relevance importance
Inconsistent zone presence across documents may skew scores
output_contract: Ranked result set ordered by combined zone-weighted scores; each result includes final score and optionally score breakdown by zone (author contribution, title contribution, abstract contribution, body contribution)

metadata.prompt: For each query term, retrieve its frequency in each zone of candidate documents. Multiply each zone frequency by its assigned weight. Sum the weighted frequencies across all zones to produce a final relevance score. Rank documents by descending score.
subsection_headings: 6.3    The vector space model for scoring

skill_drafts.name: Zone Index Encoding
skill_drafts.description: Encode zone information in an inverted index structure to support zone-aware document retrieval. Choose between dictionary-based encoding (zone labels as field extensions) or postings-based encoding (zone metadata in postings lists) based on query patterns and index constraints.
skill_drafts.objective: Store and retrieve zone metadata efficiently during query processing
applicable_signals: Document collection has multiple fields or zones (e.g., author, title, abstract)
Query logic requires zone filtering or zone-specific term weights
contraindications: Single-field documents with no zone distinction
Zone information not required for retrieval logic
Extreme memory constraints where any metadata overhead is prohibitive
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Identify all zones in the document collection', 'detail': 'List distinct fields or zones (e.g., author, title, abstract, language)'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Evaluate encoding trade-offs', 'detail': 'Dictionary encoding: compact, suitable for few zones; postings encoding: flexible, suitable for zone-weighted scoring'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Choose encoding strategy', 'detail': 'Select dictionary-based (zone as field extension) or postings-based (zone in postings list) based on query patterns and index size'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Implement zone metadata storage', 'detail': 'Encode zone labels in chosen location; ensure consistent format across all postings or dictionary entries'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Verify zone accessibility', 'detail': 'Confirm zone metadata is retrievable during query processing for zone filtering or weighted scoring'}
triggers: Building inverted index for multi-zone documents
constraints: Zone labels must be consistently defined across all documents
Encoding choice must be decided before index construction begins
Zone metadata must remain accessible during query evaluation
cautions: Zone encoding decision is made at index construction time and affects all subsequent queries
Changing encoding strategy requires index rebuild
Zone metadata overhead increases index size; balance against query performance gains
output_contract: Index structure with zone metadata embedded and accessible during query evaluation. Postings or dictionary entries include zone labels. Zone information is available for zone-restricted retrieval and zone-weighted scoring.

metadata.prompt: When constructing an inverted index for multi-zone documents, decide whether to encode zone information as extensions in dictionary entries or embed it in postings lists. Dictionary encoding is compact for few zones; postings encoding is flexible for zone-weighted scoring. Ensure zone metadata is accessible during query evaluation.
subsection_headings: 6.3    The vector space model for scoring

skill_drafts.name: Parametric Search with Field Constraints
skill_drafts.description: Filter or restrict search results by document fields (e.g., Author, Language) before or during ranking. Enables field-based filtering to reduce result set and improve precision when users need to narrow results by metadata attributes.
skill_drafts.objective: Enable field-based filtering to reduce result set and improve precision
applicable_signals: Field constraint syntax detected in query
Zone index available for the requested field
Metadata attributes present in collection schema
contraindications: No field constraints present in query
Requested metadata field not indexed or not available
Collection lacks structured zone or parametric index
workflow_steps: Parse query to extract field constraints and content terms
Validate that requested fields are indexed in the collection
Intersect content postings with field-specific postings (zone filter)
Rank filtered results using standard scoring (e.g., tf-idf)
Return filtered and ranked document set with field values visible
triggers: Query includes explicit field constraints (e.g., author:, language:, date:)
Collection has structured metadata fields indexed as zones
User requests results filtered by document attributes
constraints: Field values must be indexed and queryable
Zone encoding must be consistent (dictionary or postings)
Field constraints must be syntactically valid
cautions: Ensure field constraints are correctly parsed to avoid silent filtering failures
Verify zone index consistency before execution
Handle missing or null field values gracefully (exclude or flag)
output_contract: Filtered document set containing only documents matching both content query and all field constraints; field values displayed or used for ranking; result count reflects intersection of content and field matches

metadata.prompt: When a query includes field constraints (e.g., author:Smith, language:English) and the collection has structured metadata fields indexed, apply parametric filtering to restrict the document set to those matching both content and field criteria. Use zone indexes to encode field information either in dictionary entries or postings, then intersect field matches with content matches to produce the final ranked result set.
